Geri Dönüştürülmüş Alüminyumda Isıl İşlem Parametrelerinin Dayanıma Etkisi Deniz Yılmaz +
BİLDİRİ ÖZETİ

Bu örnek çalışma, “Geri Dönüştürülmüş Alüminyumda Isıl İşlem Parametrelerinin Dayanıma Etkisi” başlığı altında malzeme ve üretim seçeneklerini aynı karar çerçevesinde karşılaştırmayı amaçlayan bir araştırma tasarımı sunar. Yöntem, farklı sıcaklık ve bekletme sürelerinde hazırlanan numunelerin çekme deneyleriyle karşılaştırılmasını esas alır. Değerlendirmede mekanik performans, üretim maliyeti ve kullanım ömrü birlikte ele alınır. Referans yaklaşım ile önerilen seçenekler aynı sınır koşullarında karşılaştırılır; girdi varsayımları ve ölçüm belirsizlikleri ayrıca kaydedilir. Farklı çalışma koşullarıyla yürütülecek duyarlılık analizi, yaklaşımın hangi durumlarda kullanılabileceğini açıklamayı hedefler. Bildiri, uygulama öncesi kararları destekleyen tekrarlanabilir bir değerlendirme akışı önerir.

Improving Laser Cutting Edge Quality through Experimental Design Umut Bayram +
PAPER ABSTRACT

This illustrative study, titled “Improving Laser Cutting Edge Quality through Experimental Design,” presents a research design aimed at comparing material and manufacturing alternatives within a common decision framework. The methodology centers on investigation of cutting speed and laser power using factorial experimental design. Evaluation considers mechanical performance, production cost and service life together. A reference approach and the proposed alternatives are compared under identical boundary conditions, while input assumptions and measurement uncertainty are documented separately. Sensitivity analysis across operating conditions is intended to clarify where the approach could be useful. The paper proposes a reproducible evaluation workflow to support decisions before implementation.

Original Turkish titleLazer Kesim Süreçlerinde Kenar Kalitesinin Deney Tasarımıyla İyileştirilmesi

Multisensor Fusion for Autonomous Mobile Robots Yağmur Ekinci · Tuna Özdemir +
PAPER ABSTRACT

This illustrative study, titled “Multisensor Fusion for Autonomous Mobile Robots,” presents a research design aimed at jointly assessing the reliability and implementation needs of automation solutions. The methodology centers on fusion of camera and range measurements under different lighting conditions. Evaluation considers error rate, processing time and computational resource requirements together. A reference approach and the proposed alternatives are compared under identical boundary conditions, while input assumptions and measurement uncertainty are documented separately. Sensitivity analysis across operating conditions is intended to clarify where the approach could be useful. The paper proposes a reproducible evaluation workflow to support decisions before implementation.

This illustrative study, titled “Low-Loss Switching Strategies in Power Electronics,” presents a research design aimed at addressing technical and economic requirements of energy systems together. The methodology centers on simulation-based evaluation of switching frequency options under load variations. Evaluation considers energy efficiency, operating cost and behavior under variable loads together. A reference approach and the proposed alternatives are compared under identical boundary conditions, while input assumptions and measurement uncertainty are documented separately. Sensitivity analysis across operating conditions is intended to clarify where the approach could be useful. Designing Demountable Joints for Modular Steel Connections Tolga Tunç · Ceren Tekin +
PAPER ABSTRACT

This illustrative paper examines “Designing Demountable Joints for Modular Steel Connections” with the aim of comparing material and manufacturing alternatives within a common decision framework. The research plan includes comparison of bolt layouts under repeated loading and reassembly scenarios. Alternatives are to be compared in terms of mechanical performance, production cost and service life. Initial conditions, data collection steps and evaluation criteria are defined before comparison.
